title: Doggos
description:
Doggos solves CryptoKitties problem of overabundance of kitties and high churn as gameplay not fun enough and Pokemon GO's Pokemons not being unique and users not being able to prosper through their ownership.

Thus Doggos is an AR-based game where you can explore the real world by saving and adopting, breeding, trading and growing rare NFT-based dogs only you own. By playing, players give home to real life homeless dogs as 2.5% of all proceeds will be donated to dog shelters.

By combining the best of CryptoKitties and Pokemon Go, we believe AR x NFTs is the opportunity to bring crypto to mainstream.
how_its_made:
NFT contracts are built on top of Ethereum ERC721. To interact with blockchain we have built iOS and Android native app that are directly communicating with the blockchain.

* iOS app uses ARKit and RealityKit with RealityComposer to bring the real life animations to life. For NFT communications we use web3swift.

* Android app uses OpenGL and ARCore for visuals. For NFT communications we use web3j.
